name: uta-japanese-song-learning
description: 通过逐句跟唱学习日语歌词的桌面与网页应用
author: CosmerHomura

scripts.dev: npm run lyrics:sync && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web "npm run api" "npm run web"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run lyrics:sync && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,desktop "vite" "electron desktop/main.cjs --dev"
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run desktop:backend && electron-builder --dir --win --x64
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run desktop:backend && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
